frame_fits.review: User-approved reuse of Metal_Doorframe_002 from the same CC BY pack. Adapt its aperture to the larger standalone 002 leaf while retaining jamb/header profile widths and depth. Side rails translate outward; connecting spans lengthen. The rectangular header stays behind the arched top outline at the outer-edge height. Original leaf dimensions/shape/UV and frame UVs are preserved; this is a reconstructed mounting, not an original manufacturer assembly.

modifications: Compose original Metal_Door_002 with the existing frame Metal_Doorframe_002 from its pack, translated to the same center and floor. Double doors excluded.
Fit the template frame aperture through reviewed source-coordinate intervals; preserve its jamb/header profiles and depth.
Uniform overall scale 0.895, proper Z-up rotation and inferred left back-face hinge opposite the expected interaction side.
Mount the original slab 2 mm ahead of the jamb face and 2 mm above the floor; no leaf shrink, collision exclusion or threshold relaxation.
Use a conservative whole-leaf hull and component-partitioned frame hulls. Start closed and already unlatched.
clearance_review: Preserve the complete 002 slab without extra moving scale. Surface-mount it in front of the explicitly adapted pack frame; about 12.7 mm overlap per jamb at overall scale 0.895, 2 mm depth/floor gaps. Frame opening has approximately 0.888 m width; no decorative surface or collision is removed.
